title: Harden Tdarr Matrix Full Run Evidence
summary: Harden Tdarr Matrix full-run evidence by pinning generated DynamicHdrPolicy, increasing full-library prepare-evidence timeouts, replaying existing worker artifacts in report mode, and emitting structured worker-child startup failure results.
reason: The completed 100 percent Tdarr Matrix run exposed stale generated config failures, a queue-snapshot timeout, and generic missing worker-result findings that obscured whether failures were pipeline defects or harness evidence gaps.
behavior_before: Tdarr Matrix generated configs could omit newer required config keys, full/report queue snapshots used a 600 second prepare timeout, worker-child startup/config failures could exit before writing worker_result.json, and report mode did not replay existing per-file worker evidence.
behavior_after: Tdarr Matrix generated configs explicitly set DynamicHdrPolicy to warn, full/report/strict prepare evidence gets an 1800 second timeout, worker-child config/bootstrap failures write local_worker_result.v1 startup failure JSON, and report mode can rebuild findings from existing stdout/stderr/worker_result artifacts without reprocessing media.
manual_validation: manual: worker-child temp config missing SourceMovies wrote local_worker_result.v1 with CONFIG_SCHEMA_INVALID
rollback_plan: Revert the generator replacement for DynamicHdrPolicy, restore Tdarr Matrix prepare-timeout preset/default values to 600, remove the early worker-child startup-result writer and report-mode worker evidence replay, then rerun the targeted Python and PowerShell checks.
